meta.name: The Watcher
meta.description: Ominous letters. Strange neighbors. Sinister threats. A family moves into their suburban dream home, only to discover they've inherited a nightmare.

videos.title: Welcome, Friends
videos.overview: Soon after the Brannock family moves into their dream home, they receive a threatening letter from a mysterious sender — and suffer an unexpected loss.

videos.title: Blood Sacrifice
videos.overview: After hiring a private detective, Dean speaks with a former homeowner who's still shaken by what he endured. Nora and the kids move into a motel.

videos.title: Someone to Watch Over Me
videos.overview: As Dean digs deeper into the house's history, Theodora discovers Dakota's disturbing screen name — and Ellie's secret relationship comes to light.

videos.title: Occam's Razor
videos.overview: Nora thinks Dean wrote the letters to scare her into selling, but a DNA test yields surprising results. Contractors uncover something in the basement.

videos.title: The Gloaming
videos.overview: Dean and Nora find a hidden room where someone's been living. Theodora shares intriguing intel about Roger Kaplan. The family makes a fateful decision.

videos.title: Haunting
videos.overview: Nora urges Dean to move on, but the past continues to haunt him. A shocking confession doesn't add up. Back at the house, keen eyes continue to watch.

meta.slogan: Based on the shocking true story.
